# Remastered Modding Field Manual

> Techniques and facts about modding the Command & Conquer Remastered Collection (Steam app 1213210), verified in a
> working mod. Each page is self-contained and laid out the same way: when you need it, the fact or method, how it
> was verified, the game build it holds for, and what is still unproven. Licensed CC BY 4.0. EA has not endorsed and
> does not support this product.

Every page's frontmatter carries `holds_for` (the Steam build it was verified on), `status`, and `unproven` (the
claims not yet tested). Pages that patch the launcher's memory also carry `clientg_sha256`. Before applying any
offset from such a page, check the SHA-256 of the user's `ClientG.exe` against it, and stop if they differ.

## Getting started

- [The mod folder and ccmod.json](getting-started/the-mod-folder-and-ccmod-json.md): a mod is ccmod.json plus a
  Data/ tree; local mods in Documents\CnCRemastered\Mods\Red_Alert (or Tiberian_Dawn); Workshop items need a named
  subfolder; the version is two integers shown as high.low.
- [Building the DLL on Linux](getting-started/building-the-dll-on-linux.md): cross-compile the game DLL with
  32-bit mingw (i686 toolchain, Vanilla Conquer's remaster preset, VC_CXX_FLAGS="-w;-fpermissive"); strip it
  before shipping.
- [Testing under Proton and on the Steam Deck](getting-started/testing-under-proton.md): copy the mod into the
  game's Proton prefix (compatdata/1213210) with rsync -ac --delete, with the game closed; crashes are logged in
  log/CrashLog.txt.
- [Publishing to the Workshop from Linux](getting-started/publishing-to-the-workshop-from-linux.md): a SteamUGC
  uploader using EA's .workshop.json fields; restart Steam first, description at most 8000 characters, upload real
  folders in a named subfolder.

- [HD-only mods](getting-started/hd-only-mods.md): the manual assumes HD graphics mode; switch off the classic
  option with CNCDisableLegacyGraphicsOption in GameConstants_Mod.xml when new art exists only in HD.

## Launcher data

- [Overriding the launcher's data](launcher-data/overriding-launcher-data.md): a loose file under Data/ replaces
  its CONFIG.MEG member whole; a replacement CONFIG.MEG must keep every member's exact size; GameConstants_Mod.xml
  merges over GameConstants.xml (overwrite="true" replaces a list). The instance server reads none of them.
- [New text strings](launcher-data/new-text-strings.md): add strings with a loose Data/ModText.csv (UTF-16 LE with
  a BOM; TEXT ID, AUDIO TAG, CHARACTER, then a column per language), merged at load; the MASTERTEXTFILE .LOC table
  can only be relabelled at its exact size.
- [Mod hotkey commands](launcher-data/mod-hotkey-commands.md): CNCEnableModHotKeyGameCommands turns on
  GAME_COMMAND_CNC_MOD_COMMAND_1-4; the DLL gets INPUT_REQUEST_MOD_GAME_COMMAND_n_AT_POSITION with the cell under
  the mouse; players bind the keys, a mod can't ship bindings.

## Using what the player already owns

- [TD art from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-art-from-the-base-game.md): draw Tiberian Dawn's HD
  art in a Red Alert mod from the base game's TEXTURES_TD_SRGB.MEG, using opener tiles, instead of shipping copies.
- [TD theatres in Red Alert](using-what-the-player-owns/td-theatres-in-red-alert.md): add TD's desert, temperate
  and winter as Red Alert theatres: launcher slots in GameConstants_Mod.xml, a matching TheaterType and templates
  in the DLL.
- [TD sounds from the base game](using-what-the-player-owns/td-sounds-from-the-base-game.md): play Tiberian
  Dawn's sound effects and EVA lines in a Red Alert mod from the base game's sound MEGs, by naming each sound in the
  DLL and adding RAC_/RAR_ alias events; your own samples must be MS-ADPCM.
- [Content built from the player's own games](using-what-the-player-owns/content-from-the-players-own-games.md):
  EA's guidelines bar music files from any C&C game, so convert Tiberian Sun's soundtrack from the player's own copy
  (MIX/AUD to the Remastered MS-ADPCM WAVs) instead of shipping it. Conversion proven; in-game importer is design
  only.

## Maps and the lobby

- [New maps in the skirmish Official list](maps-and-lobby/new-maps-in-the-skirmish-list.md): list maps with
  INSTANCES.XML and CNCMAPPREVIEWDATA.XML (RA's 128-wide grid); start them under Hastings' D6 entry, whose
  OverrideMapName the DLL honours, by hooking ClientG's launch sends and key lookup. Fragile: one ClientG build.
- [Bigger maps](maps-and-lobby/bigger-maps.md): maps up to 255 cells a side (253x253 playable): widen CELL to
  32 bits with 8-bit X/Y, patch InstanceServerG's two export copies (0x59235A, 0x5982A4) to read bigger arrays,
  re-encode offsets on the launcher's 128-wide grid, skip the legacy render. Byte cell fields cap it at 255.

- [Adding a theatre of your own](maps-and-lobby/custom-theatres.md): the slot, DLL theatre and template steps
  are proven by TD's theatres; a new tileset file (not in TILESETS.XML), its video-memory cost, and isometric (TS)
  terrain on the square grid are unproven.
- [Custom campaigns](maps-and-lobby/custom-campaigns.md): INSTANCES.XML decides what Mission Select shows
  (ShowOnMissionSelect, IsUnlockedAtStart, ExternalGameID), the campaign files what launches; replace a stock
  mission by shipping its scenario (SC<house><nn><dir><var>.INI) in CCDATA/ without [Digest].
- [Per-AI lobby difficulty](maps-and-lobby/per-ai-lobby-difficulty.md): the launcher never sends per-AI skirmish
  difficulty to the DLL; read ClientG's AIPLAYERn records (stride 0xA8: team +0x50, ActLike +0x54, difficulty
  +0x64, colour +0x68) and pick the live copy. Read-only. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Sound and music

- [Launcher-played EVA lines by faction](sound-and-music/launcher-eva-lines-by-faction.md): nine EVA lines are
  played by ClientG itself; write each faction's recording over the launcher's sample names at match start, and
  over ClientG's cached copy (same-length payloads, whole-file compare before writing). Fragile: one ClientG build.
- [Credit tick and radar sounds by faction](sound-and-music/credit-tick-and-radar-by-faction.md): the launcher
  plays both itself; silence its copy and fire the faction's sound from the DLL under new event names, per house.
- [Music by faction, and the jukebox](sound-and-music/music-by-faction-and-the-jukebox.md): AUDIO_FACTIONS
  MusicMap is unused and the DLL can't play music, so redirect ClientG's skirmish music lookup to a per-faction
  event; jukebox entries are removed only before the jukebox manager's setup. Fragile: one ClientG build.

## Engine

- [What the launcher owns: the modding walls](engine/what-the-launcher-owns.md): each behaviour ClientG owns,
  with its route (data, cached-record RAM, launcher code patch) or the evidence it's a real wall. Search data
  first, then the DLL interface, then ClientG memory, then code.
- [Adding a faction](engine/adding-a-faction.md): houses are a fixed enum, so a new side rides one of the
  lobby's eight country rows, either remapped to HOUSE_GOOD/HOUSE_BAD or decoupled from its side mask.
- [LAN games](engine/lan-games.md): only the host runs the simulation and the DLL; PlayerPtr switches per player,
  sounds are addressed per house, DLL keyboard reads see the host only, and every player needs the same mods.
- [Save versions](engine/save-versions.md): SAVEGAME_VERSION is the sum of class sizes and DLLLoad runs before
  the version check, so lead the DLL's save data with your own marker and version.

## Art

- [How the launcher draws sprites](art/how-the-launcher-draws-sprites.md): an HD frame's .meta is a canvas size
  plus a crop box, anchored by canvas centre; second draws use shapes 0-127; no rotation; alpha below ~128
  discarded; ground shadows are baked (black, alpha 191); beam line frames 0-4 only, 3 lines per object.

- [Building selection boxes](art/building-selection-boxes.md): the launcher centres a building's selection box on
  its plot and takes only the size from the DLL; a misplaced box means the art is seated off the plot's centre.

## Patching the launcher in memory (advanced)

- [Re-pointing launcher UI art in memory](clientg-ram/repointing-atlas-regions.md): give a third faction or
  sub-faction its own radar crest and HUD logos by rewriting ClientG's cached atlas-region records. Fragile:
  verified against one ClientG build only.
- [Patching the launcher's code from your DLL](clientg-ram/patching-the-launchers-code.md): ClientG loads the
  mod's DLL at start-up for CNC_Version; DllMain there can pin the DLL and hook launcher functions on every machine.
  Compare stock bytes before every write. Fragile: one ClientG build only.
- [Rewriting launcher strings in memory](clientg-ram/rewriting-launcher-strings.md): when ClientG builds a name
  in code (the sidebar tab-icon prefixes), rewrite the string in place, never longer, keeping the old tail behind
  the terminator so a patched slot is findable. Fragile: one ClientG build.
